name: Bretonnian Knights

specialRules.name: Blessing of the Lady
specialRules.text: Before each game, make a Leadership test against the warband leader's Leadership. If passed, any enemy model wishing to fire a black powder weapon must roll 7+ on a D12 or it may not fire (test each time). Other shooting weapons (bows, crossbows) need no test, except that any enemy model shooting at a Bretonnian Knight (Questing Knights and Knights Errant only) must first roll 7+ on a D12.

items.name: Barding
items.note: Rare 11. Armour for a warhorse; mounted model gets an extra +1 armour save (+2 instead of +1 for being mounted). A barded mount is only killed on a roll of 1-2 on D12 (instead of 1-4) if the model is taken out of action. Warhorse only.

fighters.name: Questing Knight

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Questing Knight may use his Leadership when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Knights Virtue
specialRules.text: Never panics and breaks from combat, and does not have to pass a Leadership test for being all alone.

fighters.notes: Exactly one required. 'Special' skill list is the Bretonnian Special Skills (virtues).

fighters.name: Knight Errant

specialRules.name: Knights Virtue
specialRules.text: Never panics and breaks from combat, and does not have to pass a Leadership test for being all alone.

fighters.notes: May not ride a warhorse unless the Questing Knight also rides one.

fighters.name: Squire
fighters.notes: May not have more Squires than Knights. May not ride a horse unless the Questing Knight and any Knight Errant are riding warhorses.

Special.name: Virtue of Purity
Special.text: Any spell cast against the knight is dispelled on a D12 roll of 7+.

Special.name: Virtue of Valour
Special.text: When fighting a model with higher Strength than himself, the Knight may re-roll failed to-hit rolls in hand-to-hand combat.

Special.name: Virtue of Discipline
Special.text: Once per game, if the knight is not out of action, stunned or knocked down, he may re-roll a failed rout test.

Special.name: Virtue of Noble Disdain
Special.text: Subject to Hatred of all enemies armed with shooting weapons.

Special.name: Virtue of Impetuous
Special.text: May add +D3" to his move when charging; roll each time before moving.

conversionNotes: Blessing of the Lady: black powder 4+ on D6 -> 7+ on D12; shooting at Knights 4+ -> 7+.
Barding: mount killed on 1 (instead of 1 or 2) on D6 -> 1-2 (instead of 1-4) on D12 (proportional).
Squires are heroes in this warband (0-3, 15gc, 0 exp); the PDF lists them under Heroes with the Squires equipment list. Limit 'no more Squires than Knights' recorded in notes.
Special skill list is custom (Bretonnian Special Skills) and stored in the extra top-level skillLists field; 'Special' appears in skills for Questing Knight, Knight Errant and Squire.
Men-at-arms limit 0-8 per heading; Bowmen any number. Max 12 warband size.
Blessing of the Lady is a pre-game Leadership test against the leader; failure just means no blessing.
